title: Apple iPhone 15 Pro (128GB)
description: Apple's iPhone 15 Pro with A17 Pro, a 6.1-inch 120Hz ProMotion OLED display and 128GB storage. The listed AED price is converted to an approximate INR display price, not a verified Indian retail price.
pros: A17 Pro is the newer and generally more capable chip than A15 Bionic.
6.1-inch OLED with 120Hz refresh rate and 2556 × 1179 resolution on the supplied listing.
Titanium frame and IP68 water/dust resistance are listed for this model.
cons: Converted price is about ₹51,784 and is not a confirmed India-market price.
128GB storage may be limiting for large video libraries or games.
Battery condition, warranty, seller reliability and whether the unit is new/refurbished must be checked on the actual listing.

review.summary: On the supplied specifications, the iPhone 15 Pro ranks ahead of the iPhone 13 Pro for overall performance because it uses the newer A17 Pro chip. Its 120Hz OLED display and IP68 rating are strengths on paper. This is specification-based guidance, not a hands-on test; seller-provided RAM and CPU clock figures should be independently verified.
review.bestFor: People who prioritise stronger performance, a premium compact phone and a 120Hz OLED display, provided the unit condition and warranty check out.
review.notIdealFor: Buyers who need the lowest price, more than 128GB storage, or a confirmed local warranty without checking the seller details.
strengths: A17 Pro is newer than the iPhone 13 Pro's A15 Bionic.
120Hz OLED display with the supplied 2556 × 1179 resolution.
IP68 water/dust resistance is a model-level specification; it does not mean damage from liquids is covered by warranty.
limitations: Approximate ₹51,784 conversion is not a verified Indian retail price.
The 128GB capacity is fixed and cannot be expanded with a memory card.
Real battery health, previous repairs, warranty and seller condition are unknown from the supplied details.
verifyBeforeBuying: Confirm the exact model, storage, new/refurbished status and seller rating.
Check battery health, activation/repair history and warranty coverage.
Confirm final checkout price, return policy and region/network compatibility.
Do not treat water resistance as permanent or as a guarantee against liquid damage.

title: Apple iPhone 13 Pro (128GB)
description: Apple's iPhone 13 Pro with A15 Bionic, a 6.1-inch 120Hz ProMotion OLED display and 128GB storage. The listed AED price is converted to an approximate INR display price, not a verified Indian retail price.
pros: Lower converted price than the iPhone 15 Pro while retaining a 120Hz OLED display.
A15 Bionic remains capable for everyday use, subject to battery health and software support needs.
Triple-camera system and IP68 rating are part of the model's published specifications.
cons: A15 Bionic is an older chip than the A17 Pro in iPhone 15 Pro.
Approximate ₹39,723 conversion is not a confirmed Indian retail price.
Battery health and remaining warranty are especially important for an older model.

specs.Operating System: iOS 15 (original launch OS; current version depends on updates)

review.summary: The iPhone 13 Pro offers much of the same 120Hz OLED display experience at a lower converted price, so it is the value-oriented option in this two-phone comparison. Its A15 Bionic is older than the A17 Pro, and the actual value depends heavily on battery health, condition, warranty and final seller price. The supplied 1920 × 1080 resolution was corrected to the model specification of 2532 × 1170.
review.bestFor: Buyers who want a premium 120Hz iPhone experience at a lower upfront cost and can verify the unit's condition.
review.notIdealFor: People who need the newest chip, a fresh battery guarantee, or a seller-backed warranty that has not been confirmed.
strengths: Costs about ₹12,061 less than the listed iPhone 15 Pro after the same indicative currency conversion.
6.1-inch OLED display with 120Hz ProMotion refresh rate.
IP68 is the model's water/dust resistance rating, subject to condition and exclusions.
limitations: A15 Bionic is an older generation than A17 Pro.
Battery degradation is a key risk on an older/used unit.
The converted price is not a verified Indian retail price and seller details are not supplied.
